integrity: Analytic filter factorization and positive-kernel support proof; independent computational checks are corroborative, not a substitute for the proof. Publication priority and independent scientific audit have not been established.
scientific_limitations: Identifiability from ideal all-lag population covariance and an exact essential support edge, not from finite noisy samples.
Known model class, symmetric telegraph force, positive coefficients, no additional thermal noise, normalized known mass.
Support edge formula is used only for nonnegative mechanical Green kernels at or beyond critical damping.
title: Spectral threefold ambiguity and support-edge identification in a telegraph-driven inertial trap
